state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Netflix in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Netflix; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Some users express excitement about renewing their Netflix subscriptions to watch movies like those featuring serial killers or childhood favorites. Several tweets describe relaxing at home in sweats or bed while binge-watching shows such as South Park, The Walking Dead, and How I Met Your Mother. A few individuals complain that the service does not load properly or wish they could access content without paying the monthly fee. Others mention feeling lonely while watching alone or getting into arguments with partners over shared account passwords. Some users also note that Netflix offers a wide variety of genres, from comedy to horror, making it a go-to option for entertainment.
